description: This file is a Bash script that implements a Git update hook for access control. The script enforces branch and tag policies, checks user permissions based on configuration files, and provides mechanisms to grant or deny push operations on repository refs.

methods.name: grant
methods.description: Outputs 'grant' and exits with status 0, allowing the push.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Outputs 'deny' and exits with status 1, denying the push.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs informational messages when verbose mode is enabled.
